Przystajń, Kraków and the High Tatras, 20 December 2026 – 3 January 2027

Three people, fourteen nights: Christmas with family at Wilcza Góra, the turn of the year under the Tatras, then Kraków before the flight home. Rail throughout, except the coach over the border. Nothing is booked yet.

Getting there and back (not booked)

  • Sun 20 Dec: Eindhoven 13:15 → Katowice 15:00, Wizz Air, €180 each. The same flight on Saturday the 19th costs €225.
  • Sun 3 Jan: Kraków 11:35 → Eindhoven 13:35, Ryanair, €147 each.
  • Tilburg to Eindhoven airport is about an hour by train and bus.
  • Prices found 19 September 2026, cabin bag only. Fares rise as seats sell.

Where you sleep

Nights Where Arrive Leave
6 Przystajń, with family Sun 20 Dec Sat 26 Dec
6 Starý Smokovec Sat 26 Dec Fri 1 Jan
2 Kraków Fri 1 Jan Sun 3 Jan

Book the Tatra nights first: New Year fills early and prices peak.

The other option is to come down on 31 December instead, giving five nights in the mountains and three in Kraków, with New Year's Eve in the city. The Rynek party is one of the biggest in Poland, and Kraków beds cost most that night. The plan below keeps the quiet version.

Route

Częstochowa → Kraków, 26 Dec IC Reymont 07:27 → 08:51, direct 1 h 24
Kraków → Starý Smokovec, 26 Dec FlixBus 10:25 → 13:20, direct 2 h 55
Starý Smokovec → Kraków, 1 Jan FlixBus 17:05 → 19:45, direct 2 h 40

Katowice airport is 50 km from Przystajń, so family collecting you there saves the coach altogether. The airport also has its own station now, with trains towards Zawiercie and Częstochowa.

The 26th is one long travel day, about six hours door to door, with an hour and a half in Kraków between train and coach. A later train reaches Kraków at 10:18, but that leaves seven minutes to change: too tight with bags.

Day by day

Sun 20 Dec — Arrive Katowice · night 1 of 6, Przystajń

Land 15:00. Coach to Częstochowa at 15:55, or collected at the airport.

Mon 21 Dec – Fri 25 Dec — Przystajń · nights 2–6 of 6

Christmas at home. Wigilia on the 24th: everything shuts early, and shops and museums are closed on the 25th. Trains run a Sunday timetable on both days. Częstochowa is 40 minutes away if you want an outing: Jasna Góra, or the old market square and the museum.

Sat 26 Dec — To the Tatras · night 1 of 6, Smokovec

Train from Częstochowa 07:27, Kraków 08:51; coach at 10:25 from the bus station beside Kraków Główny, Starý Smokovec 13:20. Afternoon: the funicular up to Hrebienok and the Tatra Ice Dome, a carved ice chapel rebuilt each winter, free to enter.

Sun 27 Dec – Thu 31 Dec — Five days from one base · nights 2–6 of 6

Pick as the weather allows:

  • Studenovodské waterfalls and the huts. From Hrebienok on foot to the frozen falls, then Rainerova útulňa or Zamkovského chata. The hut routes stay open all winter; tea and goulash at the end.
  • Tatranská Lomnica. Cable car to Skalnaté pleso, and on to Lomnický štít if the wind allows. The TANAP museum is in the village.
  • Štrbské Pleso. The lake circuit on snow, and the track towards Popradské pleso. Cross-country trails start here.
  • Belianska Cave. Open 27–31 December, Tuesday to Sunday, tours at 9:30, 11:00, 12:30 and 14:00. Bus to Tatranská Kotlina.
  • Ždiar. Goral village of painted timber houses, 30 minutes by bus.
  • Kežmarok. Castle and the wooden articular church, a UNESCO site, built without nails. Half an hour from Poprad.
  • Poprad. Thermal pools at AquaCity, and Spišská Sobota, the old merchant quarter.
  • New Year's Eve. Smokovec is subdued: a meal, and fireworks over the valley. Štrbské Pleso is the livelier option if you want it.

Fri 1 Jan — Down to Kraków · night 1 of 2, Kraków

A last morning on the hill; the railway runs a holiday timetable. Coach at 17:05, in Kraków 19:45. Book somewhere to eat: 1 January is quiet and many kitchens shut.

Sat 2 Jan — Kraków · night 2 of 2

The one full day in the city. The old town and Wawel, or the quieter route: Kazimierz's synagogues and squares, over the river to Podgórze, up the Krakus mound for the view. The Christmas market closes on 1 January, so you have missed it; the museums are open.

Sun 3 Jan — Fly home

Train to the airport, flight 11:35, Eindhoven 13:35.

Getting around the Tatras

The electric railway (TEŽ) links Poprad, Starý Smokovec and Štrbské Pleso, with a branch to Tatranská Lomnica. A 24-hour ticket is €4, two hours €2. Buying paper tickets at a counter adds €1 a person per journey, so use the machines or the app.

Winter notes

  • High trails are shut from 1 November to 15 June: no ridges, saddles or peaks. Open are the hut routes, Hrebienok, the waterfalls and the Slavkovská viewpoint. That is enough for five days, but it is valley walking.
  • Daylight is short: light by about 07:30, dark by 16:00.
  • Kit. Microspikes or crampons for icy paths, proper layers, sunglasses. Sledges are hired at Hrebienok for the run back down.

Verify before booking

  • Beds in Smokovec over New Year. The scarce item in this plan.
  • Coach times for 26 December and 1 January. From the published timetable; confirm and book the seats. Both run on the holidays as things stand.
  • Whether family collect you at Katowice airport on the 20th.
  • Belianska Cave. Confirm the tours and reserve.
  • Cable cars. Lomnický štít needs booking and closes in wind.
  • Kraków airport train on 3 January, first departures and journey time.
  • Somewhere to eat in Kraków on 1 January, and in Smokovec on New Year's Eve.
  • Baggage for three people on both flights, and whether the fares still hold.
